13/// A Pantone Fashion, Home + Interiors (FHI) color.
14///
15/// The enum covers the 2310 colors of the Pantone FHI system - each
16/// color is identified by a `NN-NNNN` code and a name
17/// (`Pantone 19-4057 TCX True Blue`). In contrast to
18/// [`crate::PantoneNamedColor`] (the print-mixing PMS vocabulary),
19/// FHI colors describe dyed or coated material swatches and share
20/// their names across the substrate suffixes - see
21/// [`PantoneFhiSuffix`]. The canonical string uses `TCX`; `TPX` is
22/// discontinued and `TPG` is the current paper guide.
23///
24/// [`FromStr`] accepts the canonical `Pantone <code> TCX <name>`
25/// form, a bare `<code>` or `<code> <suffix>` (`19-4057`,
26/// `19-4057 TPX`) and the bare color name (`True Blue`), all
27/// case-insensitively. [`Display`] and the wire format use the
28/// canonical form.
29///
30/// The stored sRGB values are community approximations of the
31/// physical swatches as published in the
32/// [pantone-colors dataset](https://github.com/geoffreycrofte/pantone-colors);
33/// FHI colors are defined for textiles and interiors, so the
34/// values are indicative rather than authoritative. PANTONE is a
35/// trademark of Pantone LLC.
36#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
37#[cfg_attr(feature = "schemars", derive(schemars::JsonSchema))]
38pub enum PantoneFhiNamedColor {

13918    /// The canonical substrate suffix used by [`Self::as_str`].
13919    ///
13920    /// FHI colors are material-independent names; the canonical
13921    /// string resolves the cotton `TCX` guide, which is the dataset
13922    /// these sRGB approximations are based on.
13923    pub const fn suffix(&self) -> PantoneFhiSuffix {
13924        PantoneFhiSuffix::Cotton
13925    }

16243    /// The color as opaque byte components.
16244    pub const fn to_color(&self) -> Color<u8> {
16245        Color::from_rgb_u32(self.packed_rgb())
16246    }
16247
16248    /// The nearest FHI color to `color` in the sRGB space - squared
16249    /// Euclidean distance over the RGB channels, alpha ignored.
16250    pub fn nearest(color: &Color<u8>) -> Self {
16251        // `ALL` is a non-empty const table, so the minimum always exists.
16252        Self::ALL
16253            .iter()
16254            .min_by_key(|candidate| color.squared_rgb_distance(&candidate.to_color()))
16255            .copied()
16256            .unwrap_or(Self::Egret)
16257    }

18575    /// Whether `s` is one of the accepted spellings of this color:
18576    /// the canonical name, a bare code, a code with any
18577    /// [`PantoneFhiSuffix`] or the bare color name.
18578    fn accepts(&self, s: &str) -> bool {
18579        if s.eq_ignore_ascii_case(self.as_str()) || s.eq_ignore_ascii_case(self.name()) || s.eq_ignore_ascii_case(self.code()) {
18580            return true;
18581        }
18582        let Some(suffix) = s.strip_prefix(self.code()).and_then(|rest| rest.strip_prefix(' ')) else {
18583            return false;
18584        };
18585        suffix.parse::<PantoneFhiSuffix>().is_ok()
18586    }
18587}

18589impl FromStr for PantoneFhiNamedColor {
18590    type Err = ParseColorError;
18591
18592    fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
18593        Self::ALL
18594            .iter()
18595            .find(|color| color.accepts(s))
18596            .copied()
18597            .ok_or_else(|| ParseColorError::UnknownPantoneFhiColor { input: s.into() })
18598    }
18599}

18604        f.write_str(self.as_str())
18605    }

18654#[cfg(test)]
18655mod tests {
18656    use super::*;
18657
18658    #[test]
18659    fn all_covers_the_2310_colors() {
18660        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::ALL.len(), 2310);
18661    }
18662
18663    #[test]
18664    fn all_is_sorted_by_code() {
18665        let names: Vec<&str> = PantoneFhiNamedColor::ALL.iter().map(PantoneFhiNamedColor::as_str).collect();
18666        let mut sorted = names.clone();
18667        sorted.sort();
18668        assert_eq!(names, sorted);
18669    }
18670
18671    #[test]
18672    fn code_and_name_split_the_canonical_string() {
18673        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue.code(), "19-4057");
18674        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue.name(), "True Blue");
18675        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::BrightWhite.code(), "11-0601");
18676        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::JetBlack.name(), "Jet Black");
18677    }
18678
18679    #[test]
18680    fn from_str_is_case_insensitive() {
18681        assert_eq!("Pantone 19-4057 TCX True Blue".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue);
18682        assert_eq!("pantone 19-4057 tcx true blue".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue);
18683    }
18684
18685    #[test]
18686    fn from_str_accepts_bare_forms_and_other_suffixes() {
18687        assert_eq!("19-4057".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue);
18688        assert_eq!("19-4057 TPX".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue);
18689        assert_eq!("19-4057 tpg".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue);
18690        assert_eq!("True Blue".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue);
18691        assert_eq!("turquoise".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap(), PantoneFhiNamedColor::Turquoise);
18692    }
18693
18694    #[test]
18695    fn display_and_as_str_produce_the_canonical_name() {
18696        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue.to_string(), "Pantone 19-4057 TCX True Blue");
18697        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::JetBlack.as_str(), "Pantone 19-0303 TCX Jet Black");
18698    }
18699
18700    #[test]
18701    fn display_from_str_round_trip_covers_all_colors() {
18702        for color in PantoneFhiNamedColor::ALL {
18703            assert_eq!(color.to_string().parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap(), *color);
18704        }
18705    }
18706
18707    #[test]
18708    fn to_color_maps_names_to_srgb() {
18709        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue.to_color(), Color::<u8>::new(0x1E, 0x44, 0x77));
18710        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::Turquoise.to_color(), Color::<u8>::new(0x45, 0xB5, 0xAA));
18711    }
18712
18713    #[test]
18714    fn nearest_finds_the_closest_named_color() {
18715        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::nearest(&Color::<u8>::new(0x1E, 0x44, 0x77)), PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue);
18716        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::nearest(&Color::<u8>::new(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)), PantoneFhiNamedColor::BrightWhite);
18717    }
18718
18719    #[test]
18720    fn suffix_is_the_canonical_cotton_guide() {
18721        assert_eq!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue.suffix(), PantoneFhiSuffix::Cotton);
18722        assert!(PantoneFhiNamedColor::ALL.iter().all(|color| color.suffix() == PantoneFhiSuffix::Cotton));
18723    }
18724
18725    #[test]
18726    fn unknown_names_are_rejected() {
18727        assert!("Pantone 99-9999 TCX Nope".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().is_err());
18728        assert!("19-4057 XX".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().is_err());
18729        assert_eq!(
18730            "red".parse::<PantoneFhiNamedColor>().unwrap_err(),
18731            ParseColorError::UnknownPantoneFhiColor { input: "red".into() }
18732        );
18733    }

18735    #[test]

18738        assert_eq!(json, "\"Pantone 19-4057 TCX True Blue\"");

18742    #[cfg(feature = "zbus")]

18746        let context = zvariant::serialized::Context::new_dbus(zvariant::LE, 0);
18747        let bytes = zvariant::to_bytes(context, &PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue).unwrap();
18748        let decoded: PantoneFhiNamedColor = bytes.deserialize().unwrap().0;
18749        assert_eq!(decoded, PantoneFhiNamedColor::TrueBlue);
